title: Need improvements
body:
Editing frequency of habits has bugs (initial frequency of weekdays can be changed to daily, but cannot be changed back again to weekdays; you need to wait the next day to edit back to weekdays successfully). Editing time of reminder needs several times scrolling downward before the time is editable.
UI is good, having to press down on a big button to log a habit is kinda fun. Pricing is too high.
author: &8i5

title: Good, but subscription’s too expensive 😭
body: I agree with that other review, the monthly/annual subscription’s way too expensive for what’s basically a fancy reminder app. The price should be cut by at least 50% in my opinion, so you guys still make a profit but the subscription’s more affordable. Honestly, this app is one of the best in terms of design and functionality, but I’m uninstalling after the trial is done. We got way too many expensive app subscriptions these days, I am NOT adding another one to my list.
author: Chrispychimken

title: Just a fancy reminder app
body: This is definitely not worth the expensive premium price knowing that this is just a basic reminder app with fancy visuals. I love the book, the lessons. Make it $9 a year and see the app’s popularity explode
